name: JSE Limited
source: Yahoo Finance | blank split cells computed from the file's own stored totals (Gross Profit = Revenue - Cost of Sales; the current/non-current split sums to the total) | CRON 2026-10-12: H1 2026 column completed from JSE Limited unreviewed interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026, the exchange's own SENS results announcement, figures in R million. Printed: total income 1 984; total expenditure 1 210; earnings before interest and tax 774; net finance income 89; income tax expense 239; net profit after tax 652; earnings per share 816.2 cents. Operating Expenses is the printed total expenditure of R1 210m. Operating Profit (EBIT) is the printed EBIT of R774m. Net Finance Costs is stored negative because the issuer printed net finance INCOME of R89m, following the dataset convention for a net finance income. Income Tax is the printed charge of R239m. Profit Before Tax 891 is the printed income tax expense 239 plus the printed net profit after tax 652, because the issuer summary prints no separate pre tax line. Revenue 1 882 and Net Profit 652 were already stored from the same announcement and are unchanged. Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit exactly, 891 less 239 equals 652. The issuer prints no cost of sales or gross profit for the half, so those cells stay empty.
